item.tib: dbang khrid byin rlabs sprin dpung
item.coloph: de ltar dbang khrid byin rlabs sprin dpung 'di/ mched grogs dam pa'i gsung gis bskul ba la/ brten nas skyang sprul nam rgyal bdag gis bsgrigs/ ma rtog log pa'i 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa/ ye shes spyan can rnams la mthol lo bshags/ ka dag rnal ma'i ngang du bzod par gsol/ brtsams pa'i dge 'bras phyi rabs sgrub pa pos/ smin 'jug dbang gi gtsug phud thob par shog/
